backtest_protocol.execution_model: Signal uses only close-of-day OHLCV available on the signal date; paper entry is next available open with production entry slippage; exit is the close ten trading days after the signal with target-side sell slippage and ROUND_TRIP_COST_PCT.

gate2.note: The sleeve uses only same-day and prior-day OHLCV fields plus next-open/exit prices available to the replay. It does not ask LLM or production to infer hidden fields.
runtime_fields: SPY OHLCV rows for same-window relative strength
QQQ OHLCV Close on signal date and 20 trading days prior
SPY OHLCV Close on signal date and 20 trading days prior
candidate ticker Date/Open/High/Low/Close/Volume for prior pocket-pivot scan

gate3.note: No core filter is added. The pocket-pivot condition gates only the default-off paper variant; core signals_generated/signals_survived remain unchanged.

gate_questions.1_alpha_hypothesis: entry / candidate_pool: among existing QQQ-confirmed volatility-contraction candidates, prior pocket-pivot support may isolate stronger accumulation before the breakout.

2_history_check.exp-20260426-045: Observed-only volatility-contraction scout; mixed and recent-window negative.
2_history_check.exp-20260525-020: Raw top-1 volatility-contraction sleeve rejected on late_strong/drawdown.
2_history_check.exp-20260525-022: QQQ > SPY 20d confirmation passed with +1.2493 aggregate EV and +$23,409.56 PnL.
2_history_check.exp-20260525-024: Accepted shared default-off forward paper adapter for exp-022.

gate_questions.4_acceptance_standard: Same docs/backtesting.md three fixed windows; pocket variant must have >=20 selected trades and at least one in each window, pass core guardrails, beat exp-022 aggregate EV by >=5%, avoid EV/PnL regression vs exp-022 in every window, keep max drawdown drift <=0.50pp, and pass concentration guards.

hypothesis: Among exp-20260525-022 QQQ-confirmed volatility-contraction candidates, a PIT-safe prior pocket-pivot support signal may identify stronger institutional accumulation before the breakout and improve replacement value, tail risk, or concentration.
interpretation: Pocket-pivot support did not clear Gate 4. Do not promote it as a replacement or allocation rule; keep only the read-only bucket attribution and metadata surface.
next_evidence_needed: If revisited, require fresh forward paper evidence or a materially new non-threshold confirmation source. Do not retune pocket-pivot scan or volume thresholds on the frozen three-window sample.

market_confirmation_gate.field: QQQ 20 trading-day close-to-close return > SPY 20 trading-day close-to-close return
market_confirmation_gate.known_at: after signal-date close, before next-open paper entry

pocket_pivot_support_gate.definition: An up day whose volume is strictly greater than the maximum volume of all down days in that up day's prior 10 trading days.
pocket_pivot_support_gate.scan_window: prior 10 trading days only; signal date excluded

production_impact.promotion_requirement: The field may appear only as metadata unless a future Gate 1-4 activation/replacement experiment explicitly promotes it.

source_exp022_selected_trade_bucket_attr.interpretation: Read-only attribution of exp-022 selected paper trades by whether the same PIT-safe prior pocket-pivot support was present.

why_not_other_changes: Did not add 60-minute/15-minute Kova timing, fundamentals, 13F/institutional ownership, RS Rating, CAN SLIM filters, ATR retunes, QQQ/SPY retunes, rank retunes, notional changes, hold-day changes, or exit changes. The only tested variable is PIT-safe prior pocket-pivot support.
